messages.subject: Difficulty estimating latent factor with a planned missingness approach (Mplus)
parts:
Hi all,
I am having difficulty estimating a latent factor. I am attempted to estimate a latent factor using indicators from measures A and B. Some indicators from A and B overlap in content, but the vast majority of items from the measures do not. I am conducting this analysis in Mplus. I am planning on conducting this as a clustered "Type = complex" analysis using categorical data (WSLMSV preferred). The models do not produce outputs or model fit because of large missingness.

Any advice or guidance would be greatly appreciated!
Best,
Jordan
